authority: Creator/Human Authority > LeeWay Standards > Root of Trust > Canonical Formula > Runtime Fabric > Agent Lee > Harness > Formula > Skills/Tools > Execution > Veritas > Receipt > Learning Ledger
purpose: Make LeeWay accumulate governed capability so models are replaceable cognitive engines rather than the sole repository of intelligence.

formulaArchitecture.promotion: Factory candidate -> qualification -> canonical comparison -> authorization -> Fabric staging -> verification -> promotion

modelArchitecture.identityLaw: Agent Lee persists; models are replaceable cognitive engines.
modelArchitecture.target: Expand task classes where a governed small-model system meets the same predefined acceptance criteria as a larger reference model.
modelArchitecture.prohibitedClaim: Do not equate parameter count or claim 1B=100B without experiment evidence.

learningArchitecture.cognitiveLoadTransfer: MODEL_REASONING -> EVIDENCE -> FORMULA_KNOWLEDGE/SKILL -> WORKFLOW -> DETERMINISTIC_TOOL -> RUNTIME_CAPABILITY -> AUTOMATIC_ROUTING

evidenceBoundary.rule: Do not promote structural presence or design intent to runtime proof.

changeControl.lockedMeaning: Architecture baseline; refinement may add evidence/capability but cannot silently weaken authority, evidence boundaries, canonical Formula law, human authority or completion path.
changeControl.reopeningRule: Reopen settled architecture only with new evidence, explicit Creator direction, or verified conflict with higher authority.
changeControl.mutationRule: Change this baseline by explicit versioned commit with rationale and evidence impact.
